subject: Error when running makeMethylDB on large file

messages.author: 072c955112d6766c
messages.subject: Error when running makeMethylDB on large file
parts:
Hi, when running makeMethylDB on a large file I get the error 

Error in paste(tabixRes[[1]], collapse = "\n") : 

  result would exceed 2^31-1 bytes

Basically, I am doing unite on ~80 individuals, then running selectByOverlap to remove some chromosomes from the file then that leaves me with a methylBase (not a DB anymore) so I am trying to use makeMethylDB to convert back to methylBaseDB but I get this error.

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: Error when running makeMethylDB on large file
parts:
Hi,
This kind of error usually occurs when trying to read the whole data of a large tabix file back into memory, so I am wondering why it occurs upon writing out the object. 

However, to circumvent the problem in the first place you may use the internal helper function applyTbxByChr (https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/blob/9620cd686a14483f2158c75805c952d066c7b7f8/R/tabix.functions.R#L874). 
This helper function applies a function on tabix files chromosome by chromosome and returns the path to the new tabix files index. It is not exported, so you may check the arguments from the link to the code. Please note that this function does not write a new tabix header. 
Here is some example code for a function to subset your object based on chromosomes : 

newDBIndexPath <- methylKit:::applyTbxByChr(getDBPath(object),
dir = getwd(), 
filename = newDBFilename,
chrs = chromosomesToKeep,
return.type = "tabix",
FUN = function(x) { 
# this function only returns its input
x }
)

Best,
Alex
